rules.name: Keep the rear-camera half fixed
rules.rule: For a foldable product reveal, keep the camera-side panel stable and rotate only the cover panel around a clear hinge. This gives the audience a readable anchor while the product opens.

rules.name: Project screen content from the front view
rules.rule: Keep the browser, SaaS dashboard, product page or campaign artwork aligned to one front-view coordinate system while the device folds. Reproject the outer panel instead of stretching the UI with the mesh.

rules.name: Use progressive edge treatment
rules.rule: As a panel recedes, progressively reduce visible coverage and add deterministic blur or darkening toward its folded edge. Keep the effect bounded so copy and product details remain legible.

rules.name: Plan screen modes
rules.rule: Offer intentional modes for wallpaper, launcher, custom media, browser flow, SaaS dashboard, product page and social proof. Use real user copy and media; never invent reviews or metrics.

rules.name: Give the fold a beat
rules.rule: Use a deliberate closed hold, open reveal, readable hold, and optional return or peek. Land the logo, feature, browser result or CTA on the stable open state rather than during the hinge blur.

rules.name: Use the duo as a promotion stage
rules.rule: For a SaaS launch: closed device hook → hinge opens → browser or app flow plays on the inner screens → outer panel carries the concise CTA → finish on a clean product lockup. Keep all stages editable.

rules.name: Make media replaceable
rules.rule: Let users replace wallpaper, screenshot, browser capture, product image or UI copy without rebuilding geometry. Keep screen projection, crop, safe areas and fold timing independent from content.

rules.name: Separate orbit from fold controls
rules.rule: A 3D product view may orbit or zoom, but its timeline fold control must remain deterministic and independently editable. Preview controls must not become wall-clock animation in export.

rules.name: Respect reference assets
rules.rule: Use the motion idea and implementation pattern without bundling Apple reference models or screenshots. Link to original sources and disclose trademarks and asset restrictions.

rules.name: Translate into the host renderer
rules.rule: When the target is NewBrand Studio, implement the fold as a native deterministic scene that shares the preview/export renderer. Do not execute the upstream webpage or require a remote Three.js asset at render time.
